To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• the number of adults taking up sports increased between 1977 to1987; • the rate of increase in indoor sport was much faster than in outdoor sport; • there were significant increases in the number of people taking part in sports that are relatively new to Britain; • there was a significant increase in the proportion of women taking up sports; • there was no evidence that people are becoming less fit; • there is no evidence of a significant increase in sports injury rates.
there has been considerable dynamism in sports and physical recreation participation behaviour in Britain over the past 10 years.
